title: Payment Issues
description: Common payment issues and solutions, including failed payments, refund problems, and payment gateway errors.
content:
Payment Issues

This guide helps you troubleshoot common payment issues and resolve payment-related problems in your Tijraa store.

Failed Payments

Common Causes

  • Insufficient funds
  • Incorrect card details
  • Card expired
  • Bank declined transaction
  • Payment gateway issues
  • Network problems

Solutions

  • Ask customer to verify card details
  • Check card expiration date
  • Verify sufficient funds
  • Try different payment method
  • Contact payment gateway support
  • Check gateway status

Payment Not Processing

Issues

  • Payment stuck in processing
  • Payment not completing
  • Timeout errors
  • Gateway connection issues

Solutions

  • Check payment gateway status
  • Verify API credentials
  • Check webhook configuration
  • Review payment logs
  • Test payment in sandbox mode
  • Contact gateway support

Refund Issues

Problems

  • Refund not processing
  • Refund taking too long
  • Partial refund issues
  • Refund to wrong account

Solutions

  • Verify refund amount
  • Check original payment method
  • Review refund logs
  • Contact payment gateway
  • Process manual refund if needed

Payment Gateway Errors

Common Errors

  • Invalid API credentials
  • Webhook failures
  • SSL certificate issues
  • Rate limiting
  • Gateway downtime

Solutions

  • Verify API keys
  • Check webhook URLs
  • Ensure SSL is enabled
  • Review rate limits
  • Check gateway status page
  • Update gateway settings

Currency Issues

Problems

  • Wrong currency charged
  • Currency conversion errors
  • Multi-currency issues

Solutions

  • Verify store currency settings
  • Check payment gateway currency support
  • Review currency conversion rates
  • Update currency settings

Payment Method Not Showing

Issues

  • Payment method not available
  • Missing payment options
  • Regional restrictions

Solutions

  • Check payment gateway status
  • Verify regional availability
  • Review payment settings
  • Enable payment method
  • Check plan limitations

Prevention Tips

  • Test payments regularly
  • Monitor payment logs
  • Keep payment gateways updated
  • Use test mode for testing
  • Set up payment alerts
  • Regular security audits

Getting Help

If issues persist:

  • Check payment gateway documentation
  • Review Tijraa payment guides
  • Contact payment gateway support
  • Contact Tijraa support
  • Check system status
